## Reproduction

Minimal sanitized code/commands and namespace/configuration.

## Expected / actual

Expected result, actual result and relevant sanitized traceback/logs.

## Environment and checks

IDDQueue, Python, Dramatiq, Psycopg, PostgreSQL versions; checks already run.
Use a dedicated database for destructive functional tests.
See [contribution steps](https://github.com/wa-pis/iddqueue/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
